root_cause.text: The `ssif_probe` function in the IPMI SSIF driver fails to stop the created `ssif_info->thread` during error handling paths when initialization fails after thread creation but before interface registration.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a conditional block in the `ssif_probe` error handling section (`out:` label) to call `kthread_stop(ssif_info->thread)` if the thread exists, directly remedying the scenario described in the CVE where the kthread is not stopped on early initialization errors.
